description: List the items in one pipeline (deals, leads...), optionally only in given statuses or for given users. An empty status filter returns items in all ACTIVE statuses. LACRM: GetPipelineItems.

advanced_filters.description: AdvancedFilters, ANDed together. See https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/api_docs/v2/Advanced/Filter_Contacts for the names/operations your account supports.

Name.description: Filter name, e.g. FullName, FirstName, Group.

Operation.description: Operation, e.g. Contains, IsExactly, IsInGroupList, IsEmpty.

Value.description: Value for the operation (omit for IsEmpty-style operations).

pipeline_id.description: The pipeline id (from lacrm_list_pipelines) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

user_ids.description: Only items whose contact is assigned to these UserIds.

name: lacrm_list_pipeline_items
title: List pipeline items
